## Progression model: playing region k once (first clears, 3 stars)

c = fraction of placed gem value the player picks up (gems sit on risky spots, so c below 1 is realistic). Milestone gems are fixed rewards. Human time = bot time x 2 (assumption).
Cell pairs: gems earned in the region, minutes of play until the running total reaches the NEXT region's skip price ('never' = one pass of the region is not enough).

## Revive drain per region (c=60%)
